bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY EVENING... Combined seas 9 to 11 ft. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb current will occur around 230 PM Sunday, 300 AM Monday, and 315 PM Monday. The Sunday afternoon ebb will be strong and the Monday afternoon ebb will be very strong.
bar.ebb: afternoon ebb will be strong and the Monday afternoon ebb will be very strong
